quiz.question: Why are electrons important for electricity?

answers.answer: They are the heaviest particles in an atom
They can break free from one atom and move to another
They are locked inside the nucleus with protons
They repel all other particles equally

quiz.explanation: Electrons on the outer edge of an atom are not stuck. They can break free and jump to neighboring atoms. This movement of electrons between atoms is the entire basis of electricity.

quiz.question: How does the mass of an electron compare to a proton?

answers.answer: An electron is about 1,800 times lighter than a proton
An electron and a proton have roughly the same mass
An electron is about 1,800 times heavier than a proton
An electron has no mass at all

quiz.explanation: Electrons are incredibly small and lightweight, roughly 1,800 times lighter than a proton, which is why they can move so easily between atoms.
